note: a layer holding a blue box is drawn over the (empty) world by its LayerSet; visible FALSE hides it. Probed from the composited frame in both engines (tolerance 45 for the body's neutral tone map). pickable and objectType are checked as fields only.
gaps: pickable, objectType, pointerEvents and viewport are held: picking does not respect layers
addChildren and removeChildren rebuild the layer; this is checked in the SAI test of LayerSet only if the engine exposes them (X_ITE does), here only the fields are compared
